cached_responses.question: when is hajj 2026
cached_responses.answer:
Assalamu alaikum (peace be upon you).

According to the Islamic calendar, the exact dates of Hajj can vary each year. However, I can provide you with some general information about the upcoming Hajj season.

In Islam, the month of Dhu al-Hijjah is considered the most sacred month for Muslims. The Hajj pilgrimage takes place during the last 10 days of Dhu al-Hijjah, which typically falls in August or September of the Gregorian calendar.

For the year 2026, the first day of Hajj (known as Eid al-Adha) falls on:

Friday, October 22, 2026

The actual dates of the Hajj pilgrimage will depend on the sighting of the crescent moon and the official announcement by the Saudi authorities. As a general rule, the 9th day of Dhu al-Hijjah (Dahhul Hijjah) marks the beginning of the formal Hajj season.

Please note that these dates are subject to change based on various factors, including lunar sightings and official announcements.

If you're planning to perform Hajj or Umrah in 2026, I recommend checking with your local mosque or Islamic organization for updates on the exact dates and any other important information.
